question:
(i) Two identical neutral metal spheres are kept in contact. A positively charged rod is brought near one of them without touching. Explain the charge distribution on the two spheres.
(ii) What happens if the spheres are separated while the rod is still near them and then the rod is removed?

options.A:
(i) The sphere nearer the positive rod becomes positive and the farther one negative
(ii) Both spheres become neutral when separated
options.B:
(i) The sphere nearer the positive rod gains electrons and becomes negative; the farther one becomes positive
(ii) On separation while the rod is near, they retain equal and opposite charges; after rod removal, charge redistributes uniformly on each sphere
options.C:
(i) Both spheres become negative because electrons are attracted by the positive rod
(ii) They gain equal negative charges after separation
options.D:
(i) Both spheres remain neutral because the rod does not touch them
(ii) No charge separation occurs
